verdict.rationale: A self-serve eligibility checker is a reasonable thing to ask of an immigration law firm's website, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only service listings for O-1 and EB-1, attorney-led case strategy, and a blog post walking through an O-1 entrepreneur scenario. Nothing documents a free, structured, self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the site.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site
